Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We plan to move forward with the +200k token capacity add-on starting June 1. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of things before we issue a PO:

- Cloudline is requesting Net60 on the amended commitment (our procurement policy).
- We need a W9 and the correct legal entity name/EIN to put on the PO.
- Please confirm whether the invoices will be issued to the US parent or the EU subsidiary (we're consolidating payments to the US parent).

Can you confirm who on your side I should send the PO and W9 to so we can get this into our system this week? We have an internal target to get DocuSign executed by next Friday.

Thanks,
Sara

Sara —

Great to hear — excited to get Cloudline ramped up. Quick answers below and an ask so we can move the PO through our side:

- Net terms: Our standard for expansion amendments is Net30, but we can escalate a Net60 request to Finance for strategic customers. Given the size of the add-on we can offer a compromise of Net45 while Finance reviews Net60 approval. Can you confirm if Net45 would unblock your systems this week?
- Legal entity & EIN: Please put invoices to: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) — Ill confirm the invoice remit address in the next email.
- PO routing: Please send the completed PO and W9 to billing@redwood.ai; loop Ben for any special routing questions. For DocuSign, Ill start the amendment (add-on + term adjustment) and include Vivek and Ben on the signing order.

If Net45 is acceptable, we can issue the amendment and DocuSign tonight so your team can sign by Friday. If you need strict Net60, well need a one-business-day review window from Finance and a signed amendment before the effective date.

Next steps: please reply with which term (Net45 or Net60) you want to request, attach the PO and W9, and I'll queue the amendment.

—Marissa

Hi Sara —

Ben on Billing here. A couple of practical notes for the PO to avoid delays:

1) PO should list: Redwood Inference, Inc.; remit address: 1420 Market St, Suite 500, San Francisco CA 94103; EIN 12-3456789.
2) If you intend to consolidate to your US treasury, make the invoice remit to the US parent (as Marissa indicated). If we need to bill an EU entity instead, that requires an additional FYI for tax and VAT setup.
3) Please include your internal approver name and a valid PO number in the PO text line (we process only POs with a PO# and approver).
4) Attach the Cloudline W9 (PDF) to your reply and attach the PO PDF; well attach both to the DocuSign amendment.

Regarding terms: we can temporarily accept Net45 while Finance reviews a Net60 exception, but we require the signed amendment up front that lists Net60 as a requested term and Net45 as the interim agreed remit. That keeps both sides covered from a contractual standpoint.

Ill prepare the DocuSign envelope once I have PO + W9. If you prefer, Marissa can share a draft amendment now for review.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
